@everyone

Before we talk about the Bundle Sale, I’d love to cover a few major amazing things that have been happening behind the scenes that will be rolling out in the next 8 weeks as we continue to prep for Alpha launch (not in order).
 

NEW Infinity Wallet - Our new wallet built into your Infinity account. No blockchain/web3 experience needed to bring on new users.
,
Opening the game to thousands of early access players (post Infinity Wallet launch).
,
Secondary Marketplace beta launches for land listing/buying
,
Republic crowdfunding equity offering
,
New Coming Home build release
,

So, what are Starter Bundles? With Alpha launch on the horizon, we want new users to have the option of starting the game with a variety of popular assets. Five bundles, each one packed with different combinations of vehicles, apartments, gear, weapons, and founder outfits. The whole idea is to have ready-made packages for the players who'll be jumping in at Alpha. But before any of that happens, and to prepare for Alpha launch, we wanted to bring them to the community first, at a lower price than what anyone else will ever see.

Here's how it breaks down:


Founder: ~$3,000 value / $1,500 retail / $1,200 for you - 200 available

This tier is especially exciting as we are finally releasing the most collectible item in our history, the Bubblejett Prima 1938.
,
,
Operator: ~$1,300 value / $650 retail / $500 for you - 1,500  1600 available
,
Pathfinder: ~$500 value / $275 retail / $225 - 3,000 available
,
Pioneer: ~210 value / / $120 - 6,000 available
,
Citizen: ~$95 value /$60 retail / $50 for you - 10,000 available
,

Every tier comes with base game access. The higher you go, the more you get — land, ships, hoverbikes, exclusive founder outfits, marketplace discounts, starting IGC, the works. The Founder tier includes a restored piece of the past… the Bubblejett Prima 1938, which is limited to 200. This is a one of a kind item that is the ultimate display piece that can be placed in your apartment or put to the test on the track (yes it’s slow). Other notable items are the avatar companion (genetic blueprint), access to the Founders Club (in game), and Founders of the World name engraving. More info coming soon on each of these!

Note: some of these items are still in development. You're not getting everything in your hands the day you buy. When you grab a bundle, you're locking in today's price. As items become game-ready, they will be airdropped (we will send announcements). It's basically a pre-order, just at a way better price than what's coming later.

The Founder Bundle will be listed for sale next week. Stay tuned for more info! (edited)

With release 0.4.0 nearing, which marks some major milestones for Infinity Rising…

We’re excited to begin the Boarding Pass process for the patient gamers who completed the 10-question survey on our website. Invitations will roll out in multiple phases over the next month, which means nearly 6,000 gamers are now just one click away from downloading the game.

As they begin joining us, we ask that you welcome them the way this community always has. Thank you all for the support you’ve shown so far.

And to everyone new arriving here: welcome to Infinity Rising!

Infinity Rising Cardano Stake Pool Update
,
Hey everyone — heads up on some changes to our Cardano stake pool setup.

What's changing
We're retiring one of our two stake pools. Infinity Rising 2 will be retired at the end of Epoch 629 (May 8th). Going forward, we'll focus all operations on Infinity Rising 1.

Why
With current market conditions, we haven't been able to maintain enough active stake across both pools to keep block production efficient. Focusing on a single pool should meaningfully improve our block production rate and rewards for delegators.

 Action required if you're delegated to Pool 2
Delegation is controlled by your wallet, not by us — so we can't move your delegation for you. If you're currently delegated to Infinity Rising 2, you'll need to manually redelegate to Infinity Rising 1 from your wallet (Eternl, Lace, Yoroi, etc.).

Your ADA stays safe in your wallet throughout — you're just pointing your stake at a different pool.

Two key deadlines
Because of Cardano's 2-epoch delegation delay, there are two different deadlines depending on your goal:

 End of Epoch 628 — redelegate by here to have your stake active on Pool 1 for Epoch 630, catching the full 6-epoch boosted rewards window.

 End of Epoch 629 — final deadline before Pool 2 retires. Redelegating during Epoch 629 still avoids any long-term gap, but you'll miss the first boosted epoch (Epoch 630) and only catch 5 of the 6 boosted epochs.

TL;DR: redelegate this week to maximize rewards.

RISE drip rewards are coming back 
Starting Epoch 630, we're reactivating RISE drip rewards on Pool 1. Previously we paid 2,500 RISE per pool per epoch (5,000 total across both pools). We're keeping the same total pace on the single pool — and boosting it for the first 6 epochs to reward everyone who switches quickly:

Epochs 630–635: 10,000 RISE per epoch (2x the standard rate)
Epoch 636 onward: 5,000 RISE per epoch

Rewards remain claimable at dripdropz.io as always.

Pool IDs for reference
• Infinity Rising 1 (active): dda4bc64e339336e3f7bc158177df0c71dc760ff11cb8b0651b3ece4
• Infinity Rising 2 (retiring): 0836ac65915682ad8c7c138a61f354e31711f92f1b53442cd4a89b0b

Appreciate everyone who's been staking with us — this move is about making the pool stronger and the rewards better for the long haul. (edited)

JPG.STORE SHUTTING DOWN
,
For those that haven't read the news yet, JPG.STORE is sunsetting and will shut down their website on May 23rd. It's advised to read their announcement and to take steps necessary regarding your listed assets. 

Here is their official announcement: 

After serving the Cardano ecosystem since 2021 and sharing an incredible journey with thousands along the way, we’ve reached a point where the JPG Store & Comet platforms have to be sunset. While we deeply value the people who have supported us, the platforms have reached a stage where they are no longer sustainable to operate. 

JPG Store & Comet will continue to be online until the 23rd of May. After which, the website will be shut down, though the smart contracts will continue to live on.

Your NFTs in your self-custody wallets and the ones in the JPG Store contract stay yours regardless of our presence and will continue to be accessible via other platforms that aggregate the JPG Store smart contracts and via the Cardano CLI. 

However, users using social login wallets are requested to move their assets to their self-custody wallets within the next 30 days.

To make this transition as smooth as possible, we will remain functional throughout the final 30 days. Simply connect your standard Web3 wallet (Lace, Eternl, Flint, etc.) as usual to manage your items.

Thank you for being part of the JPG Store journey. It has been a pleasure serving this great community, and we are incredibly grateful for the support you've shown us over the years.

--- 

As you all know, we are actively working on our own Marketplace and will continue to keep you all updated on it's progress.

We are excited to announce that our public equity raise through Republic.com is approaching launch. Here's everything you need to know before it does.

What this is. Republic.com is a regulated investment platform with 3 million community members, $2.6 billion in capital deployed, 3,000+ raises supported, and 27 portfolio unicorns, including the public equity raise from Skybound Entertainment (The Walking Dead, Invincible).

Who can invest:


US investors: must be accredited under SEC rules — generally, $200K+ annual income (or $300K+ joint) for the past two years, or $1M+ in net worth excluding your primary residence. Other categories also qualify (certain licensed professionals, knowledgeable employees, qualifying entities). Republic verifies accreditation during the investment process.
,
International investors: open in most countries without an accreditation requirement, subject to your local laws. Known exclusions: Ontario and British Columbia (Canada), and OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions. Full details: Republic's international investor FAQ.
,

If you're unsure whether you qualify, create the Republic account anyway — KYC and accreditation verification both happen inside the platform and will confirm your status before launch.

What you receive. A Crowd SAFE — a security that converts into equity in the studio behind Infinity Rising upon a qualifying future financing or liquidity event. Not a token. Not a skin. Not an in-game asset. A real ownership stake in the company, on standard institutional terms.

Key Info:

Minimum Investment: $250 USD
Payment Methods: Bank Wire | ACH | Credit/Debit Cards | USDC
Valuation: 


First $250,000 invested is provided at a discounted valuation of $17.5 million USD,
,
Followed by $1,250,000 at a $20 million USD valuation
,

Why early matters. Republic surfaces high-momentum deals to its broader investor base. Rounds that build momentum early get covered, shared, and discovered by investors who've never heard of us — many of whom become long-term backers and players. Early traction helps; it doesn't determine outcomes, but it meaningfully improves them.

Do these three things today, before launch:


Create a free account at Republic.com
,
Complete identity verification (this can take hours to a couple of days — don't wait until launch day)
,
Link your funding source
,

When the deal goes live, you want to be able to invest in minutes, not in a panic. Official link coming soon.

---

For informational purposes only. This is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities except through Republic.com. The Crowd SAFE is offered under Rule 506(c) of Regulation D (US accredited investors) and Regulation S (non-US investors) of the Securities Act of 1933. Investing involves a high degree of risk, including loss of principal. Read the offering documents on the deal page before investing.

Infinity Wallet
,
We are super excited to announce our Infinity Wallet! With the Coming Home build around the corner, this is the critical step allowing us to start onboarding players at a steady pace. 

What Is a Player Owned Asset (POA)?

A Player Owned Asset (POA) is a digital item in Infinity Rising (IR) that you genuinely own. Unlike traditional in-game items, which exist only on the developer's servers and disappear if your account is closed, POAs are recorded on the blockchain, meaning ownership is yours and verifiable.

POAs include things like apartments, land plots, vehicles, premium weapons, gear, mounts, and other limited-edition collectibles.

Because POAs are real assets, you can:


Use them in-game with full mechanical effect (stats, performance, abilities)
,


Hold them as collectibles, displayed in-account with rarity details
,


Trade or sell them on marketplaces with no restrictions or TOS issues
,

 What It Is

Infinity Wallet is a wallet built for traditional gamers, not blockchain enthusiasts. It's designed to be zero-barrier-to-entry: no seed phrases to manage, no third-party apps to install, no blockchain experience necessary.

Its purpose is to securely hold your Infinity Rising Player Owned Assets (POA). The wallet is tied directly to your player account, which means:


You can view all your Infinity Rising assets in one place
,
Use them in-game
,
You can purchase assets directly with a credit card with absolutely no need to connect a 3rd party wallet (like MetaMask or Lace). They go right to your Infinity Wallet
,
You can send Infinity Rising POAs to other wallets*
,
Seamlessly transact on the upcoming secondary marketplace for assets on Base chain or Cardano
,

What It Is Not

The Infinity Wallet is built for one job: managing your Infinity Rising assets. It is not a general-purpose crypto wallet.


It will not display digital assets from outside the Infinity Rising ecosystem
,
It is not a replacement for wallets like MetaMask or Lace
,
It is account-bound and cannot be restored or imported into a third-party wallet provider
,
 Do not send non-IR digital assets to your Infinity Wallet. Assets sent from outside the IR ecosystem will not be recoverable.
,

 Getting Started

Just create or log in to your player account. You will be prompted to create your wallet by clicking a single button. There's nothing extra to set up.

How to Use It


View your assets: Open the Game Assets tab in your account to see everything you own.
,
Send assets: Sending is gated behind an opt-in toggle. Go to Settings and enable Advanced View to unlock send functionality, view your wallet addresses, and see other blockchain related info regarding orders.
,

* You must turn on “Advanced View” in your account settings to access this functionality. (edited)
